Soojin / team — I reviewed acme_redline_sow_0317.docx and the exhibit layout. High-level legal guidance below: 

1) MSA language: The exhibit reorganization is largely commercial/operational (line reassignments and fee proration). We do not need to amend core MSA terms (liability, data, confidentiality) for this reorg. A standalone change order that references the MSA and replaces Exhibits A/B with the attached PDFs will suffice.

2) Redlines: I accept most of the customer's redline edits but recommend one small change to the invoicing clause to explicitly state the amortization period (six months) and the effective billing date (first full billing cycle after signature). Proposed clause text included below.

3) Sign-off path: I need a brief confirmation from Finance that amortizing the implementation fee for Acme (DEAL-4781) into six monthly invoices is acceptable. Once Finance confirms, we prepare the change order + consolidated exhibit PDF and send to Alyssa for signature.

Proposed invoice clause (insert into change order): "The Implementation Adjustment shall be amortized evenly over six (6) consecutive monthly billing cycles, commencing with the first full billing cycle following the Effective Date of this Change Order."

I attached a draft change order template (redline-ready) to my internal note — tagging Jonas for accuracy on mapping and Soojin for approval of timeline.
